newsitem.title: UK: Anglo-Welsh Group shares debut on AIM.
newsitem.headline: Anglo-Welsh Group shares debut on AIM.

text.p: Shares in canal-boat holiday operator Anglo-Welsh Group Plc began trading on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on Wednesday.
By 1450 GMT, the shares were quoted at 108-1/2p, ahead of the 100p issue price, although no trade was registered in the stock.
The float, which was over-subscribed, raised 2.2 million stg before expenses and valued Bristol-based Anglo-Welsh at 3.05 million stg, the company said in a statement.
The proceeds have been used to fund two acquisitions bringing a further 66 boats under its control and expanding its boat-building activities.
Anglo-Welsh, established in 1994 through a management buy-in of a business originally set up in 1964, said it planned to diversify into heritage-based and self-catering/cottage holidays.
